title: Grave Robber
summary: Gothic 2D crypt explorer with a riddle ledger and local sandbox balance. October 24 inspection switched between explorer and ledger views; the recording shows Sandbox Sim with no wallet or bounty claim. MIT React/TypeScript source stores tomb state in browser localStorage and checks answers with SHA-256. The reviewed wallet helper requests sendPrivately or shield, but can return generated transaction IDs after non-rejection errors and labels a request result confirmed without a finality check. Its claim request does not submit the riddle preimage to a bounty template. Treat the current experience as a sandbox prototype; the advertised on-chain bounty and front-running protection are not established by this implementation. November 2 organizer notice: Esmeralda testnet was reset; entrants were asked to republish templates and update their submission versions where applicable. Earlier recordings document their capture dates.
cardSummary: Explore candlelit catacombs and inspect crypt riddles in a browser sandbox with a simulated bounty ledger.
creator: r4id3n
